summary: Provides a web interface for staff administration with multiple UI controls and validation mechanisms.
purpose: Facilitate staff administrative tasks, including date management, with real-time data update functionality.

fields.name: txtEndDate
fields.description: Text box for end date entry.

fields.name: btnEndDateCalendar
fields.description: Button to trigger end date calendar.

fields.name: CalendarExtender2
fields.description: Provides calendar functionality for end date selection.

fields.name: cvrEndDateAfter
fields.description: Validator to check if end date is after start date.

fields.name: chkShowWithdrawn
fields.description: Checkbox to toggle visibility of withdrawn applications.

validations: End date must match the specified format.
Start date must be a valid required field.
Custom validation ensures end date follows chronological order after start date.
system_behavior: Page initialization and rendering based on user session.
Dropdowns and grid views manage user data interaction dynamically.
